summary: Validated the triple-fix for the FranceMapPanel 'lats is undefined' regression on /previsions. Backend _degraded extension confirmed (severe-grid returns empty lats/lons/values arrays on Open-Meteo failure). Frontend valueAt + IdwOverlay + favorites rendering are now properly guarded by Array.isArray + length checks. ErrorBoundary wrapping verified via data-testid presence (not triggered in nominal/degraded paths). All regression guards passed: page survives both shapes of degraded payload (empty arrays AND missing keys) without any uncaught runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: FranceMapPanel.jsx is now 487 lines; close to but under the 700-line soft cap. Future palette/PARAMS additions should ideally be extracted to a separate module (e.g. /lib/mapPalettes.js) to keep the component focused on rendering.

valueAt guard is correct, but the same Array.isArray(grid.lats) && grid.lats.length > 0 pattern is repeated at lines 418 and 434 — consider extracting `const hasGrid = grid && Array.isArray(grid.lats) && grid.lats.length > 0` once at the top of render to DRY.
test_credentials: N/A (page is public, no auth required for /previsions render)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Triple-fix is solid. Backend curl to /api/weather/severe/grid?param=X&hour=Y always returns lats/lons/values keys (200 OK), even when Open-Meteo upstream fails (degraded=true with empty arrays). Frontend renders an amber 'Données indisponibles pour ce paramètre/échéance' badge in the top-right of the map when lats is empty, and never crashes. Mocking via page.route('**/api/weather/severe/grid**', ...) is the canonical way to reproduce the regression in CI. ErrorBoundary (data-testid=error-boundary) is only intended for a true React render crash — it correctly stayed absent during all degraded-payload tests.

rca of the issue: Original crash: FranceMapPanel.jsx valueAt() was called inside favorites.map() (line ~434) with grid.lats undefined whenever Open-Meteo timed out for a specific param/hour (the old _degraded helper returned {degraded:true, message} only, with no lats/lons/values). Triple-fix in place: (a) backend _degraded now branches on kind=='severe-grid' and returns lats/lons/values/grid_cols/grid_rows as empty arrays/zeros; (b) frontend valueAt() + IdwOverlay rendering + favorites.map() now all guard with Array.isArray(grid.lats) && grid.lats.length > 0; (c) ErrorBoundary catches any residual React render exception around FranceMapPanel and VerticalProfileChart, replacing the white-screen with an inline 'Réessayer' card. Verified on the preview URL — both new and legacy backend payload shapes are now safe.
